comment: An element can be placed into a shipped docker, and Reset to shipped takes it out. On a fresh profile the Colour Picker's Elements… page opens, layout_gesture presses Add element…, and layout_rows reads the list with the Colour Picker's own elements dimmed. The Toolbox's Brush Tool is picked, and layout_rows lists it after the Colour Picker's own rows with its switch. With Preferences closed a shot of the Colour Picker shows the Brush Tool's button under its own elements, and the control step lists it there. The default layout is loaded and a shot still shows the button. Back on the Colour Picker's page Reset to shipped is pressed through layout_gesture, layout_rows reads the Colour Picker's own rows alone, and with Preferences closed a shot shows the Colour Picker without the button. Last, the Layers docker, the one the spec names, takes the Eraser Tool through its own page the same way, and its Reset to shipped takes it out again.
